name: echo flag capture
description: Proposal, capture the flag played straight, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x on a ground strip split teal on its side and red on the other, a stand raised on each side): a plain red flag on a white pole ripples in the red stand while the creature rests at home and blinks, then it crouches and runs over in three strides with its legs taking turns and white speed dashes behind it, pulls the pole up out of the stand with an antenna ping, runs it home with the cloth trailing, plants it in its own stand with a dip, throws both arms up with happy arches as the flag goes off in a ring of white, red and ping sparks, and a fresh flag builds itself back up from the bottom of the red stand; judge whether the run reads as a run in so short a field, whether the grab and the plant read with the pole behind the hand, and whether it is still this creature.
